description: We are three university students from Athens, passionate about astrophysics, planetary and geospatial sciences, and remote sensing: a geologist and natural hazards researcher, MSc student in GIS (NKUA); a first-year geology student (NKUA) interested in GIS; and a final-year mining and metallurgical engineering student (NTUA) interested in mineralogy and GIS. The name of our team honours Lynkeus, the sharp-eyed Argonaut lookout, and our team image is Hevelius's constellation Lynx.
